description: This file contains functions and classes for quantization of neural network weights, specifically implementing per-channel int8 weight-only quantization for linear layers in PyTorch. It includes quantization primitives, a custom linear layer class, and utilities for replacing and converting modules for quantized inference.

classes.name: WeightOnlyInt8QuantHandler
classes.description: Handles quantization state creation and module conversion for weight-only int8 quantized linear layers.

classes.name: WeightOnlyInt8Linear
classes.description: Custom linear layer with int8 weights and per-channel scales for quantized inference.

methods.name: dynamically_quantize_per_channel
methods.description: Performs symmetric per-channel quantization of a tensor to a specified dtype.

methods.name: replace_linear_weight_only_int8_per_channel
methods.description: Recursively replaces nn.Linear modules with custom quantized linear modules.

methods.name: create_quantized_state_dict
methods.description: Creates a state dict with quantized weights and scales for the module.

methods.name: convert_for_runtime
methods.description: Replaces linear modules with quantized versions for runtime inference.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs linear transformation with quantized weights and scales.
